name: velora
description: VELORA — serverless fashion e-commerce (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + Firebase + Duitku + Biteship)

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:web
scripts.preview: bun run build:web && vite preview apps/web
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config apps/web/build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.db:seed:local: bun run infra/seeds/build.ts && wrangler d1 execute velora-db --local --file=./infra/seeds/generated/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: bun run infra/seeds/build.ts && wrangler d1 execute velora-db --remote --file=./infra/seeds/generated/seed.sql
